dedupe_keys.name: visitor enriched census of seven us metropolitan areas

description: The GeoDI Lab research team publishes visitor-enriched census tables for seven United States metropolitan areas using inferred home locations of 3.58 million anonymous phone users in July 2021. The release covers Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Miami, Seattle, Denver and Minneapolis–Saint Paul. Visitor-based and visit-based tables associate census attributes with the places people visit; intermediate home-visit tables cover 19–25 July. Figshare provides CSV, compressed CSV and census-block-group GeoJSON files under CC BY 4.0 at no charge. The companion repository includes demonstration data and code for reproducing aggregation from suitable inputs. Its original mobile-positioning source is commercial and is not fully released. These derived tables can inform spatial demand and activity distributions in transport and service-capacity simulations, including agent-based models such as model-matsim. Phone-user selection and inferred home locations limit population representativeness. The release covers a single month, and the repository's stated file total does not match its enumerated list; users should inspect the version-specific inventory before building automated imports.
